examples.arabic: ليلى كانت بنت صغيرة وجميلة أوي.
examples.english: Layla was a very small and beautiful girl.
examples.transliteration: Layla kanet bent soghayara we gamila awi.

examples.storyTitle: Karim's Ball and the Neighborhood Friends
An Egyptian Cooking Day in Our Home

examples.arabic: هي دايماً بتعمل أكل حلو لينا كلنا، وأولادي بيحبوه أوي.
examples.english: She always makes delicious food for all of us, and my children love it very much.
examples.transliteration: Heya dayman beta3mel akl helw leena kollena, w awladi bey7ebboh awi.

examples.arabic: الجو كان جميل أوي الصبح في حتتنا.
examples.english: The weather was very beautiful this morning in our neighborhood.
examples.transliteration: El gaw kan gameel awi el sobh fi 7atetna.
examples.storyTitle: A Beautiful Day in Our Neighborhood

examples.arabic: بعد ما نرجع البيت، هعمل سلطات فواكه متنوعة وهاشرب فنجان قهوة تاني مع صحباتي وهنتبسط أوي.
examples.english: After we return home, I will make various fruit salads and will drink another cup of coffee with my female friends, and we will enjoy ourselves very much.
examples.transliteration: Baʾd ma nergaʾ el beyt, haʾamel salatat fawakih metnawwaʾa w hashrah fangaan ʾahwa tany maʾa soḥabaty w hanetbaset ʾawy.
examples.storyTitle: An Egyptian Morning: Coffee, Music, and the Market
